TeX Gyre Pagella in this repository
===================================

What this folder holds
----------------------
texgyrepagella-regular.otf   one file of the TeX Gyre Pagella family of fonts,
                             version 2.609 (31 March 2026), byte for byte as
                             its authors released it
                             sha256 5dcecb4f1ad5802fbf4a941e3434410590feb77eb9fc00706be617c9538e100f
MANIFEST-TeX-Gyre-Pagella.txt  the family's manifest, as released
GUST-FONT-LICENSE.txt          the licence of the family, as released
LPPL-1.3c.txt                  the LaTeX Project Public License 1.3c, which the
                               GUST Font License names
README-bof3x.txt               this file, written by the bof3x project

What was changed (LPPL 1.3c, clause 6b)
---------------------------------------
This is a part of the family and not the whole of it: the regular face in
OpenType format alone, without the bold and italic faces, the Type 1 files,
the TeX support files and the documentation that the manifest lists. The
LPPL counts the distribution of a part as a modification, so this copy is a
Derived Work in the licence's words. Nothing inside the font file was
changed, and the font keeps its name.

The bof3x launcher holds the same file, unchanged, as bytes inside its
program, and draws the letters of its banner with it. The launcher shows
the letters only; it does not give the font to other programs.

Where to get the whole, unchanged family (LPPL 1.3c, clause 6d)
---------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.gust.org.pl/projects/e-foundry/tex-gyre/pagella
https://ctan.org/pkg/tex-gyre-pagella

Support (LPPL 1.3c, clause 6c)
------------------------------
The authors of TeX Gyre Pagella and GUST give no support for this copy or
for the bof3x launcher. Send a report about either to the bof3x project.
